name: Heavy Minerals Limited
summary: Heavy Minerals Limited, a Perth company dating from 2021, explores and develops mineral projects in Western Australia and Mozambique, targeting industrial garnet, ilmenite, zircon, leucoxene and rutile. Its cornerstone is the Port Gregory Garnet project, about 227 square kilometers in Western Australia. It also holds stakes in the Red Hill Prospect close to Geraldton and a project in Inhambane, Mozambique.
